This directory is missing gradle-wrapper.jar.

gradle-wrapper.jar is a small compiled binary (not source text) that Gradle
normally generates via `gradle wrapper`. Generating it here required
resolving the Android Gradle Plugin from Google's Maven repo (dl.google.com)
to evaluate build.gradle.kts, and that host is blocked by this sandbox's
egress policy — so it could not be generated in this environment.

This is not a blocker for CI: .github/workflows/android-debug-apk.yml invokes
`gradle` directly (via gradle/actions/setup-gradle) instead of `./gradlew`,
which has no dependency on this jar and runs on GitHub-hosted runners with
unrestricted network access.

gradle-wrapper.properties (this directory) and the gradlew / gradlew.bat
scripts (android/gradlew, android/gradlew.bat) are standard, deterministic
text content for the Gradle version pinned in gradle-wrapper.properties
(8.13).

To use `./gradlew` locally (e.g. from a terminal instead of Android Studio),
run one of:
  - `gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.13` from the android/ directory
    with any local Gradle install and normal network access, which will
    (re)generate gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar to match the properties
    file already committed here, or
  - Open the project in Android Studio, which will offer to sync/regenerate
    the wrapper automatically.
